verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a SaaS data/marketing platform, but nothing in the evidence documents a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of Hightouch itself. The warehouse-native, hybrid architecture keeps customer data in the customer's own warehouse, but that describes where data is stored, not running the product yourself, so it is adjacent at best and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
